name: site_id
comment: Unique identifier for the site and sample (ex. 1234_us).  If there are replicates for the sample append a letter to the end of the site ID (ex. 1234_us_a, 1234_us_b)

name: stream_name
comment: GNIS name of stream or local name (ie. Richfield Creek, Tributary to Hanson Creek)

name: site_description_general
comment: Short description of the site with reference landmarks identified.

name: site_description_habitat_type
comment: Type of habitat sampled. Choose one of riffle, pool, glide, cascade.

name: date_time_sample
comment: Date and time sample was taken.  Ideally this coincides with surveyors location which can be cross-referenced with GPS track.

name: date_time_storage
comment: Date and time sample was put in storage (bottle or filter)

name: depth_sample
comment: Depth below surface that sample is taken in metres.

name: crew_members_sample
comment: Initials of crew member collecting samples with person having phone being the first. Separate initials with space.

name: crew_members_filter
comment: Initials of crew members filtering samples with person having phone being the first. Separate initials with space.

name: mergin_user
comment: Default from mergin.

name: camera_id
comment: Initials of the person to whom the camera belongs to. Defaults to mergin_user.

name: gps_id
comment: Initials of the person to whom the GPS belongs to. Defaults to mergin_user

name: gps_waypoint_id
comment: ID of the waypoint in the GPS.

name: method_sample
comment: Grab sample in bottles or on-site filtration. Defaults to on-site filtration.

name: method_preservation
comment: Type of preservative or drying agent (ex. silica)

name: utm_zone
comment: UTM Zone (WGS 84)

name: utm_easting
comment: UTM Easting (WGS 84)

name: utm_northing
comment: UTM Northing (WGS 84)

name: filter_size_um
comment: Size of filter in microns.

name: filter_type
comment: Type of filter (ex. MCE, glass fibre)

name: filter_size_prefilter_um
comment: Size of pre-filter in microns.  Leave empty if no pre-filter used.

name: filter_volume_l
comment: Volume of water filtered to get sample in litres.

name: filter_time_start
comment: Time that filtering began

name: filter_time_end
comment: Time that filtering ended.

name: filter_time
comment: Total filter time in seconds. Can be derived from filter_time_end - filter_time_start

name: species_target
comment: Species is to be tested for in laboratory. Use species codes from FDIQ seperated by spaces

name: control_blank_field
comment: True or false of whether the sample is a field blank (ie sample is distilled water filtered in field setting to test for contamination). Defaults to false.

name: control_blank_office
comment: True or false of whether the sample is a office blank as part of QA (ie. sample of distilled water was filtered in sterile environment with minimal chance of contamination). Defaults to false.

name: control_species_present_field
comment: Species is known to be present in water sampled. Species codes from FDIQ seperated by spaces

name: species_detected_lab
comment: Species detected by the lab. Species codes from FDIQ seperated by spaces.

name: temperature
comment: Water temperature to one decimal place.

name: conductivity_us
comment: Conductivity in microsiemens. No decimals.

name: ph
comment: pH to one decimal

name: tubidity_ntu
comment: Turbidity in NTUs.

name: comments_field
comment: Relevent comments from the sampling crew (ex. sample depth varied from 10 - 20 cm).  Electrofishing conducted on same day.

name: electrofishing
comment: True or false of whether electrofishing was conducted at this site in same field season.

name: assessment_habitat
comment: True or false of whether habitat_assessment was conducted at this site in same field season.

name: assessment_stream_crossing
comment: True or false of whether electrofishing was conducted at this site in same field season.

name: assessment_uav_flight
comment: True or false of whether electrofishing was conducted at this site in same field season.

name: assessment_benthic
comment: True or false of whether electrofishing was conducted at this site in same field season.

name: lab_id
comment: Name of lab conducting analysis.

name: date_lab_submitted
comment: Date sample was submitted to lab

name: date_lab_processed
comment: Date sample was analyzed by lab.

name: comments_lab
comment: Relevant comments received from the lab.  Will need to added to table following analysis.

name: photo_site
comment: Typical view of the site from the shore with points of reference in the background

name: photo_upstream
comment: View upstream from the site.

name: photo_downstream
comment: View downstream from the site.

name: photo_extra1
comment: Extra photo taken at site. Add 1-3 word description in photo_extra1_tag.

name: photo_extra1_tag
comment: 1-3 word description of photo_extra1

name: photo_extra2
comment: Extra photo taken at site. Add 1-3 word description in photo_extra2_tag.

name: photo_extra2_tag
comment: 1-3 word description of photo_extra2

name: photo_extra3
comment: Extra photo taken at site. Add 1-3 word description in photo_extra3_tag.

name: photo_extra3_tag
comment: 1-3 word description of photo_extra3

name: methods_link1
comment: Link to relevant methods

name: methods_link2
comment: Link to relevant methods

name: methods_link3
comment: Link to relevant methods
